credit_line: Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden, Smithsonian Institution, Washington, DC, Gift of Joseph H. Hirshhorn, 1972
description: Beneath a peaceful, pale blue sky, a large, tan-colored hill stretches across the canvas. The hill is almost entirely bare save for a handful of small green bushes.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
